era_en: 1911-2004 : China (born in Jiaxing, Zhejiang - entered Nankai University in 1926 - to Hamburg in 1934 to study integral geometry under Blaschke - to Paris in 1936 to work with Elie Cartan - completed wartime groundwork in integral geometry and the intrinsic Gauss-Bonnet proof at Southwest Associated University - published the intrinsic proof of Gauss-Bonnet in 1944 - founded the Academia Sinica Institute of Mathematics in 1946 - to the United States in 1949 - professor at Berkeley from 1960 - Wolf Prize 1984 - founded the Nankai Institute in 1985 - returned to China in 2000 - died in Tianjin in 2004)
school: 整体微分几何 / 嘉当学派正统传人 / 积分几何汉堡学派继承者 / 复几何与陈类创立者 / 中国现代数学的造林人
historical_significance: 陈省身（1911-2004），二十世纪最伟大的几何学家之一，被誉为『微分几何之父』。1944 年他给出高斯-博内公式的第一个内蕴证明，把曲率与拓扑的关系从外部容器中解放出来，被公认为数学史上最优雅的证明之一；1946 年构造陈类，使复向量丛的拓扑不变量可以由曲率形式直接计算，创立陈-Weil 理论，为 Atiyah-Singer 指标定理提供核心构件；1974 年与 Simons 合作构造陈-Simons 理论，三十年后成为超弦、量子霍尔效应与拓扑物态的核心数学。他继承嘉当的活动标架法并将其系统化、全球化，把积分几何发展为系统学科（运动学公式），推动规范场论与纤维丛几何的历史性接轨（与杨振宁的对话确认数学物理同源）。他三次建所（中央研究院 1946、伯克利、南开 1985），培养了丘成桐、吴文俊等数代数学家，被公认为把中国数学带上世界舞台的总设计师。他的方法论——整体内省、类不变量构造、活动标架、联络-曲率统一、复结构借力、极小曲面直构、积分几何运动法、数学-物理接轨、东西传灯——构成一个以『让几何自己说话』为核心的完整思想体系。
historical_significance_en: Chern (1911-2004), one of the greatest geometers of the twentieth century, hailed as the 'father of modern differential geometry'. In 1944 he gave the first intrinsic proof of the Gauss-Bonnet theorem, freeing the curvature-topology relation from its external container—one of the most elegant proofs in the history of mathematics. In 1946 he constructed the Chern classes, making the topological invariants of complex vector bundles directly computable from curvature forms, founding Chern-Weil theory and supplying the core components of the Atiyah-Singer index theorem. In 1974, with Simons, he built Chern-Simons theory, which thirty years later became central mathematics of string theory, the quantum Hall effect and topological states of matter. He inherited Cartan's moving-frame method, systematized and globalized it; he developed integral geometry into a systematic discipline (the kinematic formula); and he drove the historic convergence of gauge theory with fiber-bundle geometry (the dialogues with C. N. Yang confirming one root of mathematics and physics). He founded institutes three times (Academia Sinica 1946, Berkeley, Nankai 1985), trained generations including Yau and Wu Wenjun, and is regarded as the chief architect who brought Chinese mathematics onto the world stage. His methodology—global intrinsic insight, characteristic-class construction, moving frames, connection-curvature unification, complex-structure leverage, direct construction of minimal surfaces, kinematic integral geometry, mathematics-physics convergence, and east-west lamp-passing—forms a complete system with 'letting geometry speak for itself' at its core.
unique_thinking: 他一生做减法：把外来的容器、固定的坐标系、外加的度量逐一从几何中剥掉，直到剩下的只有对象自身的语言——曲率、联络、类；然后在最裸的结构里发现，最深的问题（拓扑与分析的关系）原来一眼可见。他按数学内在的标准造结构而不问用途，三十年后物理学家排队来取；同时他把传播当作品：一年建一个所、一套讲义养几代人、把嘉当的独家方法翻译成世界语言。他自比造林人——种树的人未必摘果，但森林会自己生长。
unique_thinking_en: His life was a subtractive one: he stripped from geometry everything external—the container, the fixed frame, the imposed metric—until only the object's own language remained: curvature, connection, class; and in the barest structure he found the deepest questions (the relation of topology to analysis) visible at a glance. He built structures by mathematics' internal standards without asking their use, and thirty years later physicists queued to fetch them; meanwhile he made dissemination itself a work: an institute built in a year, lecture notes feeding generations, Cartan's private method translated into the world's language. He likened himself to a forester—the planter may not pick the fruit, but the forest grows on its own.

modes.domain_zh: 别被局部计算淹没：一个空间最深的性质写在它的整体拓扑里，内蕴的眼睛一眼看穿
modes.domain_en: Do not drown in local computation: a space's deepest properties are written in its global topology, and the intrinsic eye reads them at a glance
modes.definition_zh: 1944 年陈省身给高斯-博内公式一个内蕴证明：此前所有证明都把曲面放在三维欧氏空间的容器里，借助外部法向量做计算；陈省身看出这个定理的根本意义恰在于它是内蕴的——曲率与拓扑的关系属于曲面自身，不该依赖容器。他不做暴力计算，而是把单位球面映射（高斯映射）的度数与曲率积分联系起来，用整体拓扑对象（映射度）直接读出局部积分的总和。这一证明被后来的大师（如 Atiyah、Singer）反复引为『数学证明之美的典范』：它使高斯-博内公式从曲面的性质升级为任何高维流形（乃至更广义的复流形）上类求解的起点，直接导向后来的 Chern classes 与 Atiyah-Singer 指标定理。深意在于：他示范了『换个更好的角度，问题会自己给出答案』——不是把难题拆碎硬算，而是找到那个使答案内蕴地显然的整体视角。代价：整体视角需要深厚的结构积累，初学者看不到那条路。现代对应物：指标定理（Atiyah-Singer）、拓扑数据分析（TDA）中用整体不变量刻画数据形状、以及机器学习中的『涌现性质』——局部参数无法解释，只有整体视角读得出。
modes.definition_en: In 1944 Chern gave an intrinsic proof of the Gauss-Bonnet theorem: all earlier proofs placed the surface in the container of three-dimensional Euclidean space and computed with external normal vectors; Chern saw that the theorem's fundamental meaning lies precisely in being intrinsic—the relation between curvature and topology belongs to the surface itself, not to any container. Instead of brute computation, he connected the degree of the Gauss map to the unit sphere with the curvature integral, reading the total of the local integral directly from a global topological object (the mapping degree). Masters such as Atiyah and Singer have repeatedly cited this proof as a model of mathematical beauty: it upgraded the Gauss-Bonnet formula from a property of surfaces to the starting point for arbitrary higher-dimensional manifolds (and more general complex manifolds), leading directly to Chern classes and the Atiyah-Singer index theorem. The deeper point: he demonstrated that 'finding a better angle makes the problem answer itself'—not shattering a hard problem into brute computation, but finding the global vantage from which the answer is intrinsically obvious. The cost: the global view requires deep structural accumulation; beginners cannot see the path. Modern analogues: the Atiyah-Singer index theorem, topological data analysis characterizing data shape by global invariants, and 'emergent properties' in machine learning—inexplicable from local parameters, readable only from the whole.
modes.source_chapter: A Simple Intrinsic Proof of the Gauss-Bonnet Formula without Induced Metric (1944)；陈省身《微分几何的回顾》自述；Atiyah 对此证明的评价
modes.key_quote_zh: 好的证明不是把答案算出来——是找到那个让答案自己显形的视角。
modes.key_quote_en: A good proof does not compute the answer—it finds the vantage from which the answer reveals itself.
process_zh: 辨容器：找出问题解法中所有借助『外部容器』的非内蕴构件（外部法向量、坐标系）
寻整体：寻找一个与问题等价的整体拓扑/结构对象（映射度、不变量）来重新表述
内蕴重建：只用对象自身的语言重写论证，使容器依赖完全消失
升级检验：问新证明是否把定理推广到更广的类（高维、复流形）——能推广才是真内蕴
process_en: Diagnose the container: identify every non-intrinsic component borrowed from an external frame (ambient normal vectors, coordinates)
Seek the global: restate the problem via an equivalent global topological/structural object (mapping degree, invariant)
Rebuild intrinsically: rewrite the argument in the object's own language until container dependence vanishes
Upgrading test: ask whether the new proof extends the theorem to a wider class (higher dimensions, complex manifolds)—true intrinsicness generalizes

modes.domain_zh: 面对千变万化的几何对象，先造出它们共有的不变量——类（class）——让『哪些结构本质相同』变成可计算的问题
modes.domain_en: Facing endlessly varied geometric objects, first forge the invariants they share—classes—turning 'which structures are essentially the same' into a computable question
modes.definition_zh: 1946 年陈省身在普林斯顿构造陈类（Chern classes）：把复向量丛的『扭曲程度』量化为上同调类。此前 Whitney 与 Stiefel 已对实向量丛定义了示性类，但陈省身的陈类是第一个能用微分形式（曲率）直接计算的示性类——拓扑不变量从『抽象存在』变成『可微的计算对象』。深意在于双重性：其一，他在『几何性质』与『拓扑不变量』之间造了一座可通行的桥——曲率（分析对象）的积分给出拓扑（整体对象）的数值，这是 Weil 后来称为『陈-Weil 理论』的基础；其二，他示范了『工具先于问题』的方法论：陈类造出来时，它日后要回答的问题（指标定理、超弦的数学结构）尚未被提出——好的不变量像新造的望远镜，装好之后天空自己显出新星。代价：不变量会丢失信息（同类的不同几何被归并），且造不变量本身需要深刻的结构直觉。现代对应物：指标定理用陈类计算椭圆算子的解析指标、物理中规范场的陈数（量子霍尔效应、拓扑绝缘体）、以及机器学习中把高维数据的拓扑特征做成特征工程的不变量思路。
modes.definition_en: In 1946 at Princeton Chern constructed the Chern classes: quantifying the 'twisting' of complex vector bundles as cohomology classes. Whitney and Stiefel had defined characteristic classes for real bundles, but Chern's classes were the first computable directly via differential forms (curvature)—a topological invariant became a differentiable computational object. The deeper point is double. First, he built a passable bridge between 'geometric properties' and 'topological invariants'—integrals of curvature (analytic) yield numbers of topology (global), the foundation Weil later called Chern-Weil theory. Second, he demonstrated 'tools before problems': when Chern classes were built, the questions they would later answer (the index theorem, the mathematics of string theory) had not yet been posed—good invariants are like newly built telescopes; once mounted, the sky reveals its own new stars. The cost: invariants lose information (distinct geometries of one class merge), and forging them demands deep structural intuition. Modern analogues: the index theorem computing analytic indices of elliptic operators via Chern classes, Chern numbers of gauge fields in physics (quantum Hall effect, topological insulators), and the machine-learning practice of turning topological features of high-dimensional data into invariant features.

modes.key_quote_zh: 造一个好的不变量，胜过解一百个问题——有了它，问题会排队来见你。
modes.key_quote_en: Forging one good invariant beats solving a hundred problems—once it exists, the problems line up to meet it.

Quantify the twist: define quantities valued in a stable invariant system (cohomology)
Make it computable: ensure the invariant is computable directly from analytic objects (curvature forms)
Stay open: treat the invariant as a telescope, not an answer—expect it to answer questions not yet asked

modes.domain_zh: 别把研究对象硬塞进固定坐标系：让参照系跟着对象流动，几何的内在对称会自己走上前来
modes.domain_en: Do not cram the object into a fixed frame: let the reference frame flow with the object, and its intrinsic symmetries step forward on their own
modes.definition_zh: 陈省身一生把 Élie Cartan 的活动标架法用到极致，并称其为『微分几何中最有效的方法，没有之一』：与其在固定的欧氏坐标系里硬算曲线曲面的方程，不如在曲线每一点附着一个随曲线流动的标架（切向量、法向量），把几何信息全部写成标架本身的微分方程——曲率、挠率变成结构方程的系数，几何性质从『对外部坐标系的函数』变成『标架自身的内禀语言』。1930 年代他把这一方法系统化并传播到世界（包括战时在中国的教学与后来的美国学派），使嘉当方法从巴黎的孤本变成全球微分几何的通用语。深意在于：他把『参照系』从先天假设变成研究对象的一部分——坐标系不再 privilege 观察者，而随被观察者运动；这是相对论思想在方法论层面的完成。代价：活动标架的计算需要熟练的符号运算功底，初学者易在结构方程的记号迷宫中迷失。现代对应物：机器人学中的 Frenet-Serret 标架与 SLAM 的局部坐标系估计、计算机视觉中的局部特征描述子（SIFT 的方向归一化）、以及协变量偏移下的机器学习——让模型随数据分布流动而非固定假设。
modes.definition_en: Chern spent a lifetime pushing Élie Cartan's method of the moving frame to its limits, calling it 'the most effective method in differential geometry, bar none': rather than brute-forcing equations of curves and surfaces in fixed Euclidean coordinates, attach to each point of a curve a frame flowing with it (tangent, normal), and write all geometric information as differential equations of the frame itself—curvature and torsion become coefficients of the structure equations, and geometry turns from 'a function of external coordinates' into the frame's own intrinsic language. In the 1930s he systematized and spread the method worldwide (through wartime teaching in China and later the American school), turning Cartan's Parisian specialty into the lingua franca of global differential geometry. The deeper point: he turned 'reference frames' from an a priori assumption into part of the object of study—the coordinate system no longer privileges the observer but moves with the observed; this is the methodological completion of the relativistic idea. The cost: moving-frame computation demands fluent symbolic technique; beginners lose themselves in the notational maze of structure equations. Modern analogues: Frenet-Serret frames in robotics and local-frame estimation in SLAM, orientation-normalized local descriptors in computer vision (SIFT), and machine learning under covariate shift—let the model flow with the data distribution rather than fix assumptions.

modes.key_quote_zh: 坐标系不该是上帝钦定的——让它跟着几何对象走，对称性自己会开口。
modes.key_quote_en: Coordinate frames are not ordained by God—let them follow the geometric object, and symmetry will speak for itself.
process_zh: 去固定化：识别问题中『固定参照系』的隐含假设，宣布放弃它

Attach the frame: construct at each point a frame flowing with the object (tangent, normal, rotation)
Write the structure equations: recast all geometric information as differential equations of the frame itself

name_zh: 实践论/不证明存在就动手造：用复分析把极小曲面一个个具体造出来
name_en: 实践论/不证明存在就动手造：用复分析把极小曲面一个个具体造出来
category: 实践论/与其抽象论证存在，不如亲手把对象造出来
modes.domain_zh: 『存在吗』的最强回答是造一个出来——用复分析作为车床，把极小曲面一件件加工成形
modes.domain_en: The strongest answer to 'does it exist' is to build one—turning complex analysis into a lathe and machining minimal surfaces one by one
modes.definition_zh: 1950 年代陈省身与 Hsiung、后来与学生合作，系统研究极小曲面：他把极小曲面理论与复分析（全纯曲线）打通，使极小曲面的存在性问题从偏微分方程的抽象论证变成复几何的可构造问题——一个极小曲面对应一份全向数据（共形结构 + 全纯函数），给出数据即给出曲面。这一路线后来由他的学生与再传弟子（如 Lawson、Yau 学派）发扬，导致 Lawson 在三维球面中构造出极小曲面族、以及极小极大方法的存在性证明。陈省身本人强调『specific』：他不止步于『解存在』，而要求写出可以检验的具体对象。深意在于：他把高斯的构造性传统在二十世纪微分几何中复活——抽象存在性证明（如变分法的直接方法）给出的是『有』，陈式构造给出的是『在哪里、长什么样』；两者合起来才算掌握一个领域。代价：构造法覆盖的对象范围常小于存在性定理的适用域，一般情形仍需抽象方法。现代对应物：计算机图形学中极小曲面/极小网络的显式生成（肥皂膜模拟）、以及工程中的『先做原型再谈理论』——造出来的样例是理论的试金石。
modes.definition_en: In the 1950s Chern, with Hsiung and later with students, systematically studied minimal surfaces: he connected minimal-surface theory with complex analysis (holomorphic curves), turning the existence question from an abstract PDE argument into a constructible problem of complex geometry—a minimal surface corresponds to a piece of holomorphic data (a conformal structure plus holomorphic functions); supply the data and the surface follows. This route, developed by his students and intellectual descendants (Lawson, the Yau school), led to Lawson's constructions of minimal-surface families in the three-sphere and existence proofs by min-max methods. Chern himself stressed the 'specific': he refused to stop at 'a solution exists' and demanded explicit, checkable objects. The deeper point: he revived Gauss's constructive tradition inside twentieth-century differential geometry—abstract existence proofs (direct methods of the calculus of variations) give 'there is', Chern-style construction gives 'where, and what it looks like'; mastery requires both. The cost: constructive coverage is often narrower than the reach of existence theorems; the general case still needs abstract methods. Modern analogues: explicit generation of minimal surfaces and networks in computer graphics (soap-film simulation), and engineering's 'prototype before theory'—built examples are the touchstone of theory.
modes.source_chapter: Minimal surfaces and holomorphic curves 讲义；Chern-do Carmo-Kobayashi, Minimal submanifolds of a sphere with second fundamental form of constant length (1970)；Lawson 极小曲面构造谱系
modes.key_quote_zh: 别只告诉我解存在——把曲面给我造出来，让我能看、能算、能检验。
modes.key_quote_en: Do not merely tell me a solution exists—build the surface so I can see it, compute with it, test it.
process_zh: 数据化：把『造一个 X』翻译成『给出能唯一决定 X 的一份数据』
借力域：寻找一个构造工具丰富的领域（复分析）作为车床

检验回路：对造出的对象回代验证它满足全部定义要求
process_en: Datafy: translate 'build an X' into 'supply the data that uniquely determines X'
Borrow a workshop: find a tool-rich domain (complex analysis) to serve as the lathe
Machine piece by piece: build concrete objects from the simplest data, approaching the target
Verification loop: substitute the built object back to confirm it meets every defining requirement

name_zh: 治学观/不做单一问题的伐木工，而做整片数学风景的造林人
name_en: 治学观/不做解一题的伐木工，而做养整片风景的造林人
category: 治学观/把数学当风景养：造理论、建学派、传方法，三件事一起做
modes.domain_zh: 解一个问题是伐木，造一片理论是造林——他的成就不在砍了多少树，而在养出了整片会自己生长的森林
modes.domain_en: Solving a problem is logging; building a theory is forestry—his achievement lies not in trees felled but in a forest that now grows on its own
modes.definition_zh: 陈省身的一生是三线并进的造林工程：其一是理论线——陈类、陈-Weil 理论、陈-Simons 理论，每一项都是供后人世代采摘的『树种』而非一次性成果；其二是学派线——他先后在中央研究院数学所（1946，战后中国数学重建的总设计师）、伯克利、以及创办 Nankai 数学所（1985），亲手培养与影响了几代数学家（丘成桐、Lawson、Simons 等），他自己总结『我一生做了两件事：一是微分几何，二是把中国的数学带起来』；其三是传播线——他把嘉当的活动标架方法翻译成全球通用语言，把世界数学的地图重新画过（微分几何从边缘走向中心）。晚年他提出『二十一世纪的中国要成为数学大国』并写诗自况：『几何几何，人生几何』。深意在于：他把个人研究重新定义为公共基础设施建设——判断标准从『我解决了什么』变成『我离开后这片风景还能长出什么』。陈-Simons 理论在造出三十年后被物理学（超弦、拓扑物态）捡走，正是造林逻辑的最好注脚：树是前人种的，果是后人摘的。代价：造林人自己的单篇论文引用常不及『问题解决者』型学者的明星工作，成就评估需要数十年尺度。现代对应物：开源基础设施（Linux、LLVM）的维护者经济学、以及『平台优先于产品』的战略观。
modes.definition_en: Chern's life was a three-line forestry project. The theory line: Chern classes, Chern-Weil theory, Chern-Simons theory—each a 'seed species' for later generations to harvest, not a one-off result. The school line: founding the Institute of Mathematics of Academia Sinica (1946, chief architect of postwar Chinese mathematics), Berkeley, and the Nankai Institute (1985), personally training and shaping generations (Yau, Lawson, Simons); he summed up: 'I did two things in my life—differential geometry, and raising Chinese mathematics.' The transmission line: he translated Cartan's moving-frame method into the world's common language and redrew the map of mathematics, moving differential geometry from periphery to center. Late in life he called for China to become a mathematical power in the twenty-first century, versifying: 'geometry, geometry—how brief is life.' The deeper point: he redefined personal research as public-infrastructure building—the criterion shifts from 'what did I solve' to 'what will this landscape grow after I leave.' Chern-Simons theory, built thirty years before physics (string theory, topological states of matter) picked it up, is the best gloss on forestry logic: trees planted by predecessors, fruit picked by successors. The cost: a forester's individual papers are often less cited than star single-problem work; his kind of achievement is assessed on a decades scale. Modern analogues: the maintainer economics of open infrastructure (Linux, LLVM), and 'platform over product' strategy.
modes.source_chapter: 陈省身《学算四十年》《微分几何的回顾》自述；1985 南开数学所创办文献；Chern-Simons 1974 论文与后世物理引用谱系
modes.key_quote_zh: 我一生做了两件事：一是微分几何，二是把中国的数学带起来——树是前人种的，果是后人摘的，都不亏。
modes.key_quote_en: I did two things in my life: differential geometry, and raising Chinese mathematics—plant trees though others pick the fruit; neither is a loss.

name_zh: 本体论/把变化本身作为对象：联络是变化的规则，曲率是规则的规则
name_en: 本体论/把『变化本身』作为研究对象：联络是变化的规则，曲率是规则的规则
category: 本体论/研究变化的方法而非变化的结果
modes.domain_zh: 与其研究物体怎么动，不如研究『怎么动』的规则本身——把变化规则（联络）与规则的不自洽性（曲率）升格为第一性研究对象
modes.domain_en: Rather than study how bodies move, study the rule of moving itself—elevate the rule of change (connection) and its self-inconsistency (curvature) to first-class objects
modes.definition_zh: 二十世纪微分几何的核心革命是把『联络』（comparing nearby tangent spaces 的规则）从依附于度量的附属品升格为独立的基础结构——陈省身是这一升格的全球推动者之一：他在陈类构造、陈-Weil 理论、复几何（Hermite 流形的 Chern 联络不用度量即可定义曲率）中反复示范：联络可以先于度量存在，曲率是联络的副产品，而黎曼度量只是万千联络中的一种选择。深意在于认识论转向：传统问『这个空间的形状是什么』（度量的语言），陈省身一代问『这个空间允许哪些一致的比较规则，规则之间如何不同』（联络的语言）——前者把变化当结果研究，后者把变化当规则研究。这一转向直接孕育了规范场论：物理学家杨振宁后来明确说规范场就是纤维丛上的联络，陈省身的几何语言成为数学与物理在二十世纪下半叶重新会师的主干道。代价：抽象层级上移使入门门槛升高——先学联络再学度量，初学者失去『长度、角度』的朴素抓手。现代对应物：机器学习中的优化几何（优化算法是参数空间上的联络）、以及管理学的『流程优先于结果』——管好规则，结果自然管理。
modes.definition_en: The central revolution of twentieth-century differential geometry promoted the 'connection' (the rule for comparing nearby tangent spaces) from an appendage of the metric to an independent foundational structure—Chern was among its chief global advocates: in his construction of Chern classes, Chern-Weil theory, and complex geometry (the Chern connection on Hermitian manifolds defines curvature without needing a metric), he repeatedly demonstrated that a connection can precede the metric, that curvature is a by-product of the connection, and that a Riemannian metric is merely one choice among myriad connections. The deeper point is an epistemological turn: tradition asks 'what is this space's shape' (the language of metrics); Chern's generation asks 'what consistent comparison rules does this space admit, and how do the rules differ' (the language of connections)—the former studies change as outcome, the latter studies change as rule. The turn directly gestated gauge field theory: C. N. Yang later stated explicitly that gauge fields are connections on fiber bundles, and Chern's geometric language became the main road of the mathematics-physics reunion in the late twentieth century. The cost: raising the level of abstraction raises the entry barrier—learning connections before metrics, beginners lose the naive handholds of length and angle. Modern analogues: optimization geometry in machine learning (an optimizer is a connection on parameter space), and in management 'process over outcome'—govern the rules and outcomes govern themselves.
modes.source_chapter: Characteristic Classes of Hermitian Manifolds (1946) 的 Chern 联络构造；杨振宁-陈省身关于规范场与纤维丛的对话（《杨振宁文集》）；Chern-Weil 理论讲义
key_concepts: Hermite 流形 Chern 联络
modes.key_quote_zh: 曲率不是空间的属性，是『比较规则』不自洽的程度——管好规则，形状自己会出来。
modes.key_quote_en: Curvature is not a property of space but the degree to which the rule of comparison is inconsistent—govern the rules, and shape emerges on its own.
process_zh: 识比较：找出问题中隐含的『相邻状态如何比较』的规则（联络）
升格：把该规则从附属地位提升为独立研究对象，允许它自由选取
算不自洽：沿着环路执行比较规则，其偏差即曲率——规则的不自洽度
分离变量：区分哪些性质来自规则选择（联络），哪些来自空间本身（拓扑）
process_en: Identify comparison: find the hidden rule for 'comparing adjacent states' (the connection)
Promote: lift the rule from appendage to independent object of study, free to vary
Compute inconsistency: run the rule around loops; the discrepancy is curvature—the rule's self-inconsistency
Separate variables: distinguish properties from rule choice (connection) from those of the space itself (topology)
representative_cases_zh: Hermite 流形的 Chern 联络：不依赖度量的曲率定义，复几何的基础设施

把黎曼几何重新表述为『特定联络选择』的特例，统一诸几何

representative_cases_en: The Chern connection on Hermitian manifolds: metric-free curvature, the infrastructure of complex geometry
Chern-Weil theory: polynomials of curvature forms yield topological invariants directly
Yang-Mills and fiber bundles: gauge fields confirmed as connections; Chern's language physics' lingua franca
Riemannian geometry reformulated as a special choice of connection, unifying the geometries
The Chern-Yang dialogues of the 1970s: two fields confirming a common root
modern_applications_zh: 机器学习把优化算法理解为参数空间上的几何结构（自然梯度=特定联络），调参从碰运气变结构选择
组织管理先定决策规则与评审流程（联络），再让具体决定（曲率）自然涌现

金融风控先定义估值规则的一致性（会计联络），再审计偏差（曲率）

name_zh: 工具论/给几何装上复分析引擎：用全纯工具把刚性问题变成可算问题
name_en: 工具论/给几何装上复分析引擎：全纯工具把刚性难题变成可算问题
category: 工具论/借一个更强的结构（复结构）让弱结构里的问题变可算
modes.domain_zh: 实几何里挠头的问题，装上复结构常会突然变乖——用一个更强的结构借力，让难题的可解性整体上升
modes.domain_en: Problems intractable in real geometry often turn tame once a complex structure is fitted—borrow a stronger structure and the solvability of hard problems rises wholesale
modes.definition_zh: 陈省身一生最重要的方法选择之一是坚持在微分几何中引入复结构：他研究 Hermite 流形、Kähler 几何、全纯向量丛，证明了一旦给流形装上与度量相容的复结构，全纯函数的刚性（解析延拓、最大模原理、Riemann-Roch 型计数）就把柔性的实几何问题变成可计算的代数问题。他的复几何讲义（与 Bott 合著《Hermitian Differential Geometry》等）培养了整整一代人，直接铺垫了 Hodge 理论的几何化理解、以及后来带动弦论的 Calabi-丘空间研究。深意在于：他系统化了『结构升级换能』的方法论——当一个问题在其原生结构中不可解，寻找一个包含原生结构且性质更强的扩展结构（实数域上装复结构，实流形上装复流形结构），问题在新结构中获得原结构中不存在的解题工具；解完后再限制回原结构。这与高斯的复域同构搬运一脉相承，但陈省身把它从『单个问题的搬运』升级为『整个研究纲领的基建』。代价：复结构的强刚性同时是限制——许多实几何对象不允许相容复结构，借来的工具覆盖不了全域。现代对应物：量子计算把部分经典难题搬到复 Hilbert 空间求解、信号处理的解析信号/希尔伯特变换、以及企业数字化中『给纸质流程装上数据结构』的升级策略。
modes.definition_en: One of Chern's most consequential methodological commitments was insisting on complex structures in differential geometry: he studied Hermitian manifolds, Kähler geometry, and holomorphic vector bundles, proving that once a manifold is fitted with a complex structure compatible with its metric, the rigidity of holomorphic functions (analytic continuation, the maximum-modulus principle, Riemann-Roch-type counting) turns supple real-geometric problems into computable algebraic ones. His lecture notes (Hermitian Differential Geometry with Bott, among others) trained a whole generation and paved the way for a geometric reading of Hodge theory and the Calabi-Yau research that later powered string theory. The deeper point: he systematized 'structural upgrading for leverage'—when a problem is unsolvable in its native structure, find an extension structure containing it with stronger properties (fit a complex structure over the real one, a complex-manifold structure over the real manifold); the problem acquires, in the new structure, tools nonexistent in the old; then restrict the solution back. Continuing Gauss's complex-domain transfer, Chern upgraded it from 'ferrying single problems' to 'infrastructure for an entire research program'. The cost: the rigidity of complex structures is also a constraint—many real-geometric objects admit no compatible complex structure, and borrowed tools cannot cover everything. Modern analogues: quantum computing moving certain classical problems into complex Hilbert space, analytic signals and the Hilbert transform in signal processing, and digitization strategies that 'fit data structures onto paper processes'.
modes.source_chapter: Chern-Bott, Hermitian Differential Geometry 讲义；陈省身复几何系列论文（1946-1960 年代）；Kähler 几何与 Hodge 理论的传播谱系
modes.key_quote_zh: 实世界解不动的问题，给世界装上 i——刚性的复结构会把可解性成批送来。
modes.key_quote_en: Where the real world will not yield, fit the world with an i—rigid complex structures deliver solvability in batches.
process_zh: 辨不可解性：确认困难源于原生结构的工具贫乏而非问题本身无解
选扩展结构：寻找包含原结构、且带来强工具（解析性、对称性）的扩展

回迁检验：把解限制回原结构，核对未引入新结构才成立的假设
process_en: Diagnose intractability: confirm the difficulty stems from the native structure's tool poverty, not from the problem
Choose the extension: find a stronger extension containing the native structure (analyticity, symmetry)
Solve in the extension: compute or construct with holomorphic/algebraic tools
Retract and audit: restrict the solution back and check for assumptions valid only in the extension

name_zh: 方法论/把『随机放一个物体』变成可积对象：求平均而非逐例
name_en: 方法论/把『随机放置一个物体』变成可积对象：求平均而非逐例分析
category: 方法论/对位置与姿态的所有可能性整体积分，平均性质比个案性质更有信息
modes.domain_zh: 不要逐个研究『物体在某个位置』——对位置与姿态的所有可能性一次性积分：平均性质比个案更有信息
modes.domain_en: Do not study 'the object at this position' case by case—integrate once over all positions and orientations: average properties carry more information than particular ones
modes.definition_zh: 陈省身在 1940 年代（含战时在中国的时期）把积分几何发展成系统学科：Blaschke 在汉堡开创了这一领域，陈省身是其最重要的继承者与完成者。核心工具是『运动学公式』（Chern 的 kinematic formula）：把『随机放一个几何物体，它与固定物体相交的概率/平均交叠』写成运动群不变测度上的显式积分。其哲学深意在于统计式思维进入纯几何：单个位置毫无规律，但对全部位置与姿态积分后的平均量却是刚性不变量—— Santalo 公式、运动学主公式都出自这条线。这一『求平均而非逐例』的动作在数学史上的意义是：它把几何学与概率论的语言焊接起来，成为后来的几何概率、随机几何、乃至 Tomography（从投影平均重建）的远祖。深意还在于方法论层次：他示范了『当个体行为无规律时，把个体行为的全体作为新的研究对象』——不研究对象，研究对象的位置空间。代价：平均值抹平了极端情形，对以特例为要害的问题（如最坏情况分析）不适用。现代对应物：随机几何与无线网络建模（基站随机撒点后求平均覆盖率）、蒙特卡洛方法、以及 A/B 测试背后的『对分配空间积分』思想。
modes.definition_en: In the 1940s (including his wartime years in China) Chern developed integral geometry into a systematic discipline: Blaschke founded it in Hamburg, and Chern was its foremost heir and finisher. The core tool is the 'kinematic formula' (Chern's kinematic formula): the probability/average overlap of a randomly placed geometric body with a fixed one written as an explicit integral against the invariant measure of the motion group. The philosophical depth is statistical thinking entering pure geometry: a single position shows no law, yet the average over all positions and orientations is a rigid invariant—the Santalo formula and the kinematic principal formula both issue from this line. Historically, the move 'average rather than itemize' welded the languages of geometry and probability, becoming the ancestor of geometric probability, stochastic geometry, and ultimately tomography (reconstruction from projection averages). A further methodological point: when individual behavior is lawless, take the ensemble of individual behaviors as the new object of study—not the object, but the object's space of positions. The cost: averages erase extremes, unfit for problems whose essence is the worst case. Modern analogues: stochastic geometry in wireless-network modeling (average coverage over random base stations), Monte Carlo methods, and the A/B-test idea of integrating over the space of assignments.
modes.source_chapter: Chern, On the kinematic formula in the Euclidean space of N dimensions (1942 等系列)；Blaschke 汉堡学派文献；陈省身《积分几何》讲义
modes.key_quote_zh: 一个位置说明不了什么——把所有位置加起来，规律就自己浮出水面。
modes.key_quote_en: One position proves nothing—sum over all positions, and the law surfaces by itself.
process_zh: 参数化全体：把研究对象的所有位置/姿态编码为群参数空间

反推个案：由平均性质反推可检验的个案预测（如相交概率）
process_en: Parametrize the ensemble: encode all positions/orientations as a group parameter space
Fix the invariant measure: build a motion-invariant measure on that space
Integrate globally: write the quantity of interest as one integral over all positions, an averaged invariant
Retrace to cases: from average properties infer checkable case-level predictions (hit probabilities)

name_zh: 传播观/主动为下一个时代的物理学预备数学语言
name_en: 传播观/不追物理热点，而是提前三十年为物理预备好它需要的语言
category: 传播观/提前为未来物理预备数学语言，而非追赶当下热点
modes.domain_zh: 不追赶物理热点——提前几十年把物理学家将来需要的语言造好，等他们回头来取
modes.domain_en: Do not chase physics fashions—build, decades ahead, the language physicists will need, and wait for them to come fetch it
modes.definition_zh: 陈省身的陈类（1946）、陈-Weil 理论（1940 年代末）、陈-Simons 理论（1974）在造出时全部与物理学无关，却在数十年后被物理学逐一取用：规范场论被杨振宁确认为纤维丛上的联络（1970 年代对话）；陈-Simons 理论成为超弦、量子霍尔效应、拓扑绝缘体与任意子统计的核心数学；指标定理经陈类连接了量子场论的反常分析。陈省身本人从不做物理学，但他晚年多次指出这不是巧合：『数学与物理同源，走在不同的路上会再相遇』。深意在于传播观的倒置：他不向物理靠拢（追应用），也不闭门造车（拒应用），而是坚持按数学内在的标准造最深的结构——因为『最深』『最自然』的结构，无论造时是否知道用途，最终都会被用于描述世界。这是对『基础研究无用论』的终身反驳。代价：这一策略对个人而言周期极长——陈-Simons 的果实落在造出三十年后，造林人往往等不到摘果的季节。现代对应物：深度学习理论的数学预备（最优传输、随机矩阵）、以及开源基础软件先于应用爆发的『基建先行』现象。
modes.definition_en: Chern's classes (1946), Chern-Weil theory (late 1940s), and Chern-Simons theory (1974) had nothing to do with physics when built, yet physics drew on each decades later: gauge theory was confirmed by C. N. Yang as connections on fiber bundles (the 1970s dialogues); Chern-Simons theory became core mathematics of string theory, the quantum Hall effect, topological insulators, and anyon statistics; the index theorem, via Chern classes, connected anomaly analysis in quantum field theory. Chern himself never did physics, but observed late in life that this was no accident: 'mathematics and physics share one root; walking different roads, they meet again.' The deeper point is an inverted view of dissemination: neither leaning toward physics (chasing applications) nor shutting the door (rejecting them), he built by mathematics' internal standards the deepest structures—because the deepest, most natural structures, whatever their intended use, end up describing the world. A lifelong rebuttal to 'basic research is useless'. The cost: for the individual the cycle is extremely long—Chern-Simons fruit ripened thirty years after planting; foresters rarely live to pick. Modern analogues: the mathematical preparation of deep-learning theory (optimal transport, random matrices), and infrastructure-first open software preceding application booms.
modes.source_chapter: 杨振宁与陈省身的公开对话与书信（1980 年代）；Chern-Simons, Some properties of the Yang-Mills fields (1974)；陈省身晚年在南开与伯克利的多次演讲
modes.key_quote_zh: 数学和物理是一棵树上长的两根枝——按数学自己的标准往深处造，物理迟早会来取。
modes.key_quote_en: Mathematics and physics are two boughs of one tree—build deep by mathematics' own standard, and physics will come to fetch in due time.
process_zh: 依内在标准选题：不问当下用途，只问结构是否自然、深刻、可推广

耐心候取：接受三十年尺度的回报周期，不因暂无应用而怀疑价值
process_en: Select by internal standards: ask not current use but whether the structure is natural, deep, generalizable
Build a common language: express the structure without domain bias (bundles, connections, classes)
Keep the interface open: state theorems and proofs so other disciplines can translate and lift
Wait patiently: accept a thirty-year return cycle; never doubt value for lack of immediate application

modes.definition_zh: 陈省身的传播工程有三个层次。机构：1946 年他回国主持中央研究院数学所，一年内把战时离散的中国青年数学家重新组织成建制（吴文俊、廖山涛等由此起步）；1985 年以七十四岁高龄创办南开数学所，晚年还在推动『数学大国』愿景。讲义：他的《复几何》《微分几何讲义》以清晰可学著称，是几代人的入门书；他坚持用最朴素的语言讲最深的结构。方法翻译：他把嘉当的活动标架方法从巴黎学派的独家秘技翻译成全球通用方法——陈省身自评他的最大贡献之一是『把嘉当的方法介绍给世界』。深意在于：他把『传播』从研究的附属品升格为独立作品——一篇论文是一个点，一套讲义是一条线，一个研究所是一张网；三层叠加使他的实际学术影响远超个人论文列表。代价：传播与机构工作消耗大量个人研究时间——他中年的个人产量低于纯研究型同行，晚年以『我只是做了该做的事』自解。现代对应物：开源项目的文档与社区建设、以及企业内部的『知识管理不是副产品而是主产品』实践。
modes.definition_en: Chern's dissemination project had three layers. Institutions: in 1946 he returned to direct the Academia Sinica Institute of Mathematics, reorganizing China's scattered young mathematicians within a year (Wu Wenjun, Liao Shantao and others began there); in 1985, at seventy-four, he founded the Nankai Institute and pushed the 'mathematical power' vision into old age. Lecture notes: his Complex Geometry and differential-geometry notes are famed for clarity and learnability, entry points for generations; he insisted on the plainest language for the deepest structures. Method translation: he rendered Cartan's moving-frame method from a Paris-school specialty into a global method—Chern counted 'introducing Cartan's method to the world' among his greatest contributions. The deeper point: he elevated dissemination from a by-product of research to an independent work—one paper is a point, a set of lecture notes a line, an institute a network; the three layers together give him scholarly reach far beyond his personal paper list. The cost: dissemination and institution-building consumed much personal research time—his mid-career output trailed purely research peers; late in life he accepted it: 'I only did what needed doing.' Modern analogues: documentation and community building in open source, and the enterprise practice that knowledge management is a main product, not a by-product.

modes.key_quote_zh: 一篇论文是一个点，一套讲义是一条线，一个研究所是一张网——我愿意做网。
modes.key_quote_en: A paper is a point, lecture notes a line, an institute a network—I chose to build the network.
process_zh: 点：先有硬成果（论文与新方法），传播才有内容可传
线：把成果写成可学的讲义与教材，降低后人入门坡度
网：建机构与共同体，使传播不依赖个人寿命
验扩散：定期检验方法与人才是否在无己参与处自行生长
process_en: Point: hard results first (papers, new methods)—dissemination needs content
Line: write results into learnable notes and texts, flattening the slope for successors
Network: build institutes and communities so transmission outlives the person
Verify spread: check periodically whether methods and talent grow where one no longer participates
representative_cases_zh: 1946 年一年重建中央研究院数学所：吴文俊等第一代由此起步
《复微分几何》等讲义：几代几何学家的标准入门书
把嘉当活动标架方法译成全球通用语言，自评为主要贡献之一
1985 年创办南开数学所：74 岁高龄的第三次机构建设
培养与影响丘成桐、Lawson、Simons 等数代学者
representative_cases_en: Rebuilding the Academia Sinica institute within one year (1946): Wu Wenjun's generation began there
Hermitian differential geometry notes: the standard entry text for generations of geometers
Translating Cartan's moving-frame method into global common use—his own pick among top contributions
Founding the Nankai Institute (1985): institution-building a third time at seventy-four
Training and shaping generations: Yau, Lawson, Simons and more
modern_applications_zh: 技术专家把内部文档与教程当一等作品交付，而非会议纪要副产品
开源项目维护者三件套：核心代码（点）+ 文档教程（线）+ 社区治理（网）
企业建立内部大学与知识库，使方法论不随个人离职流失
学术导师制显式要求『方法传承』而非仅论文署名
个人职业规划包含『传播资产』建设：课程、书、社群
modern_applications_en: Technologists deliver internal docs and tutorials as first-class work, not meeting-note by-products
Open-source triad: core code (point) + docs and tutorials (line) + community governance (network)
Enterprises build internal universities and knowledge bases so methodology survives departures
Mentorship explicitly requires method transmission, not co-authorship alone
Career planning includes building 'dissemination assets': courses, books, communities
